up: Return all activity records for assay CHEMBL1613842. Include the compound ChEMBL ID, molecule pref_name, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units
FROM activities a
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE a.assay_id = (SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613842');
